args.title: Corvid Packaging: Warehouse automation in 2026 (article + companion summary)
args.body:
- Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts (Corvid Packaging, "Warehouse automation in 2026").
- Integration took twice as long as planned.
- Per the companion piece, the biggest saving was fewer mis-picks.

Sources:
- Article: https://blog.corvid.example/2026/warehouse
- Companion: https://insights.corvid.example/warehouse/companion
